decision.reason: [ev-4fcf47388827] is a single release-note line. It says only that cert-manager now uses a local fork of golang.org/x/crypto/acme, and it links PR #7752. It doesn't say why the fork was made, whether ACME behaviour differs from upstream, or whether the change affects any configuration, issuer type or version, so the change and applicability aspects can't be written. More evidence is needed, such as the PR description or diff showing whether the fork changes any behaviour, before this can be typed (for example, confirmed as an internal-only change).
